title: ReCET job spec, version 1
description: One job for `recet worker run`: its inputs by URI, its settings, the engine release that must run it, the reference data it is pinned to and where its outputs go. recet/jobspec.py checks the same rules (and the settings' types against RunConfig).

job_id.description: Names the run folder and the receipt.

release.description: The ReCET version (recet --version) that must run the job; a worker of another version refuses it.

calculation.description: RunConfig.engine: ReCET's own engine, or a CET replica such as cet-25.1.

job_zip.description: A zip holding Measure.csv and optionally ProgramCost.csv, as the web app takes a job.

settings.description: RunConfig settings (recet/docs/INPUT_FIELDS.md section 3) other than files, folders, names, engine and output format, e.g. {"acc_version": "2024", "acc_purpose": "claims", "allocate_statewide": true}.

reference_dir.description: The reference data folder on the worker; default: its RECET_DATA.

files.description: Reference files the job is pinned to, by their path in the folder (e.g. acc/2024/electric_hourly.parquet). The worker refuses the job when the folder's file differs.

allocation_version.description: The statewide factor table the run must use: the built-in table's name (statewide_factors_20260918) or a supplied sw_factors file's SHA-256.

uri.description: The folder the run's files and receipt.json go to: a path, file:// or s3://bucket/prefix/.
